requirements: R1: The backup service must start successfully by properly mounting the scripts directory instead of creating an empty directory for the backup script.

slices.title: Resolve Backup Script Bind Mount Directory Error
slices.jtbd: When implementing the script mount fix for this epic, I want to bind mount the parent scripts directory instead of the single script file, so that Docker does not initialize the script path as an empty directory.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a docker-compose deployment environment
When the backup container initializes
Then the backup script should be executed as a valid file, and the container should reach a healthy state
